div.div: أَيْكٌ أَيِكٌ , (K, TA,) like كَتِفْ, (TA, [agreeably with the verb, but in the CK اٰيِكٌ,]) is a phrase in which the latter word signifies مُثْمِرٌ [Putting forth fruit; &c.]: (K, TA:) or, as some say, it is an intensive epithet [signifying very abundant or luxuriant or tangled &c.]. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
